title: Automa Workflow Configuration
description: JSON Schema specification for Automa workflow and package automation files (*.workflow.json, *.package.json)

id.description: Unique identifier of the workflow or package

description.description: Detailed description or markdown documentation of the workflow

version.description: Version of the workflow or package (semver formatted, e.g. 1.0.0)

extVersion.description: Automa Extension / Core engine compatibility version

drawflow.description: Visual canvas data containing graph nodes, block configurations, and connecting edges

nodes.description: List of executable blocks in the workflow graph

edges.description: Connections routing execution flow between blocks

table.description: Table column definitions for workflow scraped/processed data

variables.description: Default local variables available during workflow execution

debugMode.description: Enable step-by-step debug logging and live breakpoints

blockDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds between executing consecutive blocks

saveLog.description: Automatically save execution logs upon completion

restartTimes.description: Number of retry attempts if execution encounters an error

notification.description: Show system notification when workflow finishes

execContext.description: Browser context in which the workflow executes

onError.description: Action to take when an unhandled error occurs in a block

reuseLastState.description: Persist and reuse browser state across runs

globalData.description: Global JSON data string accessible via {{globalData.key}}

id.description: Unique NanoID string identifying this block in the graph

type.description: VueFlow Component renderer type (defaults to BlockBasic)

description.description: User note or label for this specific block

url.description: URL to navigate to or request

selector.description: CSS selector or XPath targeting DOM elements

code.description: Custom JavaScript code for javascript-code blocks

delay.description: Delay duration in milliseconds or seconds

variableName.description: Variable name to store output data

conditions.description: Conditional rule assertions for branching logic

loopId.description: Identifier for the enclosing loop container

parameters.description: Input parameters declared in trigger block

sourceHandle.description: Output port name (e.g. source__fallback, source__true, source__false)
